public_rationale: Marcus said a factually unreliable AI can still be dangerous because it can be misused for propaganda and deepfakes. Records from 2024, before his post, show both. The FCC documented a generative AI deepfake of President Biden's voice, used in January 2024 robocalls that told New Hampshire voters not to vote. In May 2024 OpenAI reported five covert influence operations, including Russian and Chinese networks, that used its models to write political comments and articles. OpenAI also said these campaigns gained little reach. That limits how much harm they did, but it does not undercut the claim that such misuse happens.
limitations: The claim is about what is possible. The cases show misuse occurred, not how large its effects were.
The 2024 period is my choice. He did not name one.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: An AI being stupid or overrated does not stop it being dangerous; such AI can be misused for propaganda and deepfakes.

statement.excerpt: As I have written multiple times before this is not so. For example, a stupid AI that is blind to facts can be misused to create propaganda, or create deepfakes.
statement.document_title: Hard-forked! Casey Newton’s distorted portrait of Gary Marcus and AI skepticism

from_speaker: a stupid AI that is blind to facts
can be misused to create propaganda
thinking that if an AI is stupid (or overrated) it can't be dangerous ... this is not so
our_interpretation: Read as a claim about the present: generative AI systems that are known to be unreliable on facts were already being misused to make propaganda and deepfakes when he wrote.
He named no period. I use calendar 2024 up to the post date (2024-12-06), the most recent period public reports could cover.
Documented misuse cases count as support. How much reach or effect the misuse had is not part of the claim, which is only that such misuse can happen.
criteria.support_condition: Credible primary records from 2024, before the post date, show generative AI being used to produce propaganda or deepfakes.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No documented cases of generative AI being used for propaganda or deepfakes exist for the period, or credible sources show such use was not technically possible.
